remarks: Discover a desirable blend of comfort, privacy, and resort-style living in this three-bedroom townhome nestled within The Estates, a sought-after community in Rolling Hills Estates. Beautifully landscaped grounds, picturesque waterfalls, and an exceptional collection of amenities create a tranquil setting to enjoy the Palos Verdes Peninsula lifestyle. The inviting interior features a light-filled living room that flows naturally into the formal dining area and kitchen, creating a comfortable setting for everyday living and entertaining.
